description: SHYAM LOGISTIC is a trusted logistics partner providing reliable and efficient transport solutions across India. From full truck load to express delivery and supply chain support, we ensure excellence in every shipment.
aboutText:
SHYAM LOGISTIC was founded with a vision to make freight booking simple, transparent, and reliable for businesses and individuals across India. Under the proprietorship of Mohanlal, we have built our reputation on dependable road logistics and customer-first service.

Whether it is industrial cargo, commercial goods, or time-critical consignments, every delivery is handled with care, accountability, and proper GST documentation.

We operate from our registered office in Shalini Nagar, Sangli, Maharashtra, and coordinate routes pan-India so your goods reach safely and on time.
missionText: Our mission is to provide seamless logistics solutions that empower businesses to thrive — with speed, safety, and complete transparency on every mile.
heroSubtext: Seamless logistics solutions connecting businesses nationwide. Experience reliable transport with professional handling and on-time delivery.

faqs.question: What services does SHYAM LOGISTIC offer?
faqs.answer: We offer Full Truck Load (FTL), Part Load (PTL), Express Delivery, Supply Chain Solutions, warehousing support, and custom logistics for all types of goods booking.

faqs.question: Which areas do you cover?
faqs.answer: We coordinate pan-India road logistics from our registered office in Sangli, Maharashtra, covering major industrial and commercial routes.

faqs.question: How can I track my shipment?
faqs.answer: Call or WhatsApp us with your booking details. Our team will share current transit status and expected delivery timeline.

faqs.question: What are your delivery timelines?
faqs.answer: Timelines depend on route, cargo type, and vehicle. Share your from–to cities and we will confirm an estimated transit time with your quote.

faqs.question: How can I get a quote for your services?
faqs.answer: Use the Get Quote form on this website or call 8459858242 / 9057420562. Share cargo type, weight, and route for a clear estimate.
